channel.title: Rodrigo Souza dos Santos
channel.description: A free, fast Astro 7 starter theme to build anything on: 44 designed components, 12 colour themes, dark mode, and built-in i18n.

item.title: Five Footer Layouts, and the One That Ships
item.description: Simple, minimal, stacked, centered and columns. The default builds its own columns from your nav, your tags and your projects, and shrinks back to a single row when a site has nothing to put in them.
item.author: Hans Martens

item.title: Newsletter Signup: Collect Subscribers
item.description: A signup that posts to a Resend audience, in the footer of every page. On by default, and it tells you when its keys are missing instead of waiting for a visitor to find out.
item.author: Hans Martens

item.title: Umami Analytics: Cookieless, Built In
item.description: Umami works out of the box: private, cookieless web analytics. Set one environment variable and you get visitor numbers with no cookie banner.
item.author: Hans Martens

item.title: Updating Without Losing Your Content
item.description: Astro Rocket is installed with git clone, so updating is a git merge rather than an npm install. Here's the safe, reversible way to do it.
item.author: Hans Martens

item.title: The Click-to-Play YouTube Embed
item.description: Embed a YouTube video with one component. The page ships only a thumbnail; the player loads from youtube-nocookie.com on play, so Lighthouse stays at 100.
item.author: Hans Martens

item.title: Video Slides in Project Galleries
item.description: Project carousels now accept self-hosted video slides next to images. Here's how to use them, how they work, and why they don't cost a single Lighthouse point.
item.author: Hans Martens

item.title: Set a Custom Logo and Site Name
item.description: Swap the auto-generated monogram for your own logo, rename your site, and choose a logo-with-wordmark or logo-only header — mostly from one config file.
item.author: Hans Martens

item.title: The Stack Marquee: A Pure-CSS Tech Strip
item.description: Two rows of tech-stack cards scrolling opposite ways with no JavaScript. How the homepage marquee loop works, and why it is hidden on phones.
item.author: Hans Martens

item.title: Going Multilingual with Native i18n
item.description: How the opt-in i18n works: locale routing, the t()/tData() dictionary, an auto-localized blog, projects and pages, and how to ship a multilingual site.
item.author: Hans Martens

item.title: Blog Comments: Giscus, Cusdis or Artalk
item.description: Astro Rocket's blog comments are pluggable: pick Giscus, Cusdis, or the fully self-hosted Artalk. All three lazy-load on scroll — skip them and you pay nothing.
item.author: Hans Martens

item.title: A Footer Menu Separate From the Header
item.description: Configure the footer menu independently of the header navigation: add a Privacy link, an Imprint, or a Cookie Policy without cluttering your main nav.
item.author: Hans Martens

item.title: Table of Contents for Long Posts
item.description: An optional TOC on blog posts in three layouts — inline card, sticky sidebar, or both — with the sidebar on the left or right. Pick what fits your audience.
item.author: Hans Martens

item.title: System, Light, Dark: How Colour Mode Works
item.description: A 3-state colour mode with no flash, live OS-preference tracking, and a pill dropdown that respects what the user picked. Here is how it is built.
item.author: Hans Martens

item.title: Add a LetterGlitch Effect to Astro 7
item.description: How to drop a brand-tinted LetterGlitch canvas effect into an Astro 7 project: the full component, an Astro wrapper, and the production-ready details.
item.author: Hans Martens

item.title: Getting Started: From Install to Live
item.description: How to install, configure, and deploy Astro Rocket — covering site.config.ts, brand colours, navigation, writing posts, and deploying to Vercel.
item.author: Hans Martens

item.title: Every Configuration Toggle, Theme and Layout
item.description: A walkthrough of every configuration option: 12 colour themes, OKLCH colours, typography, radius and shadow tokens, header styles, and dark mode.
item.author: Hans Martens

item.title: Animations: How the Motion Design Works
item.description: Every animation layer in Astro Rocket: the ease-out hero entrance, the staggered scroll-reveal cascade, and how it stays smooth with no JS animation library.
item.author: Hans Martens

item.title: 44 Components Ready to Use
item.description: A 44-component UI library: buttons, cards, dialogs, forms, data display, and full page-structure components. All accessible, all themed.
item.author: Hans Martens

item.title: SEO: What's Built In and How to Configure It
item.description: Astro Rocket handles structured data, Open Graph, canonical URLs, sitemaps, and more out of the box. Here's exactly what ships and where to configure it.
item.author: Hans Martens

item.title: Hero Scroll Indicator: Hides on Scroll
item.description: Two bouncing chevrons that fade in after the hero animation and disappear the moment you start scrolling. How every part of the indicator works.
item.author: Hans Martens

item.title: A Progress Ring on the Back-to-Top Button
item.description: The back-to-top button has a circular SVG ring that fills as you scroll: brand-coloured, theme-aware, and built from CSS and a small inline script.
item.author: Hans Martens

item.title: Contact Form Setup: Resend, Vercel, GoDaddy
item.description: The contact form is wired up but needs three things to deliver email: a Resend account, a verified domain, and one environment variable on Vercel.
item.author: Hans Martens

item.title: The Scroll Progress Bar
item.description: A thin brand-coloured line that fills as you scroll. How the progress bar works, where it lives, and how to enable it on any page.
item.author: Hans Martens

item.title: The Design System: Tokens, Colours, Dark Mode
item.description: Astro Rocket uses a three-tier token architecture with OKLCH colors. Change one value and the entire site updates. Here's how it works and how to make it yours.
item.author: Hans Martens

item.title: The Hero Typing Effect: How to Tune It
item.description: The hero headline cycles through words with a typing animation. How it works, how to tune every speed and pause, and how to turn it off.
item.author: Hans Martens
